Title: Support for new redirect of URLs of Azure AD B2C is in development

Body.Content:
When you set up Azure AD B2C as an identity provider for the developer portal, users will be redirected to Azure AD B2C for sign-up and sign-in. In the past, the URL login.microsoftonline.com was used. Recently, Azure AD B2C has introduced a new URL – b2clogin.com, and plans to retire the old one at a future time.   

 

As a result, we have been working on changes to support the new redirect URL and let customers to choose which URL to use. We will add a new "Authority" field in the Identity Provider entity, where customers can specify the redirect URL. This feature will also be useful when Azure AD B2C introduces support for custom redirect URLs in the future. 

 

Learn more about Azure API Management.
